tax.text: Kiley voted for and championed the One Big Beautiful Bill Act's tax cuts, calling them major tax relief for Californians.
tax.quote: Californians will soon get something long overdue: major tax relief.

schools.text: Kiley championed federal school-choice tax credits, calling for a nationwide expansion of education choice.
schools.quote: We now have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to turn the tide by catalyzing a school choice revolution across America.

safety.text: Secured federal funding for a regional firearms training facility for law-enforcement agencies.
safety.quote: To construct a modern indoor firearms training facility providing year-round, reliable training for law enforcement agencies across the region.

immigration.text: Opposed additional immediate immigration-enforcement funding without bipartisan reforms, including body cameras, warrants, training, and nonenforcement zones near schools.
immigration.quote: Congress needed to come together with bipartisan reforms to restore trust and focus the mission of our immigration agencies.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Kiley pressed the California Interscholastic Federation to bar transgender athletes from girls' sports, invoking Title IX protections for women's sports.
gender.quote: The integrity of women's sports is non-negotiable; you must act to uphold these fundamental protections

energy.text: Kiley authored and won enactment of legislation reversing California's gas-car mandate to keep gasoline vehicles available.
energy.quote: We have officially reversed an extreme and unworkable mandate from Governor Newsom that would have harmed millions of people in California and across the country.

voting.text: Kiley voiced support for Californians' right to vote by mail and welcomed a court decision blocking a restriction on mail ballots.
voting.quote: I support the right of Californians to vote by mail and am grateful for the Supreme Court's decision.

trade.text: Pan says he will work to roll back tariffs he blames for raising prices on Californians.
trade.quote: fight to roll back Trump's tariff taxes that are raising prices on Californians

debt.text: Pan pledges to defend the Affordable Care Act and Medicare from cuts.
debt.quote: In Congress, Dr. Pan will stop Trump from gutting the Affordable Care Act, protect Medicare

safety.text: Pan says he would fund mental health services and community-based violence prevention programs alongside support for first responders.
safety.quote: In Congress he’ll invest in first responders, mental health grants, and community-based violence prevention programs that stop crime before people are hurt.

immigration.text: Pan says he helped immigrants get legal assistance and will fight for a path to citizenship.
immigration.quote: Dr. Pan helped immigrants obtain legal assistance to protect their rights and will fight for a path to citizenship.

guns.text: Pan backs stronger background checks, secure firearm storage, and other measures to reduce gun violence.
guns.quote: stronger background checks, secure firearm storage, community violence prevention, gun violence research, and keeping weapons of war out of our communities

abortion.text: Pan says he protected abortion rights after Roe was overturned and would work to codify Roe in Congress.
abortion.quote: Dr Pan protected abortion rights after Roe v. Wade was overturned and ensured coverage for abortion access and contraception.

health.text: Pan touts expanding public health coverage, citing state laws that cut insulin prices and secured coverage for more Californians, and vows to protect the ACA and Medicare.
health.quote: Dr. Pan passed laws that cut the price of insulin and secured healthcare for millions more Californians.
